name: Raccoon AI
description: A general-purpose collaborative AI agent and workspace that can browse, build, and deliver real results across the full stack. Achieved SOTA on GAIA benchmark at 92.67% and ranked #1 on Product Hunt with 299 upvotes.
community_quotes: A general purpose collaborative AI agent - Cursor for anything

name: Agent Browser
description: A browser automation layer for AI agents that uses ASCII wireframes instead of screenshots or DOM dumps, dramatically reducing token usage while enabling agents to control real browsers through numbered element references.
community_quotes: Stop wasting tokens on screenshots - uses ASCII wireframes instead
Ranked #1 on Product Hunt March 12 with 139 upvotes
Instead of 2MB screenshots or 50K lines of HTML, agents get simplified wireframes

name: InsForge
description: An open-source backend platform with 2.3K GitHub stars that provides AI agents with everything they need to build scalable fullstack applications including databases, authentication, storage, and serverless functions.
community_quotes: The first backend platform made specifically for AI agents to go from prompt to production
Open source backend with 2.3K stars on GitHub - gives agents database, auth, storage, functions

name: ELVES
description: A shared workspace platform that gives multiple AI coding agents a unified environment with shared memory and a single place to ship code from, solving the chaos of switching between different AI agents.
community_quotes: Switching between AI coding agents is chaos. ELVES gives them a shared workspace, shared memory, and a single place to ship from

name: Firecrawl CLI
description: A CLI tool that gives AI agents comprehensive web data capabilities including scraping, crawling, search, and browser automation. Installed via 'npx skills add firecrawl/cli' and compatible with Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI.
community_quotes: Five core commands: scrape, search, browser - gives AI agents web scraping, crawling and search capabilities
Helps reduce hallucinations by providing real web context to AI coding agents

name: CodeYam CLI & Memory
description: A free, local-first CLI tool with CodeYam Memory that acts as a memory layer for AI coding sessions. Uses a background agent to review transcripts and identify patterns to prevent Claude Code from repeating mistakes.
community_quotes: Free to download and use, requires no registration and only runs locally
Addressed Claude Code's tendency to repeat the same mistakes by adding a memory layer
Comprehensive memory management for AI coding sessions

name: Agent Skills
description: The largest cross-platform directory of AI agent skills with 100K+ skills across 30+ platforms including Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Codex, and Gemini CLI. Features security audits on every listing and serves as both directory and installation layer.

name: Sonarly
description: A YC W26-backed AI platform that autonomously fixes production bugs by connecting to monitoring tools like Sentry and Datadog. Performs alert triage, root cause investigation, and generates fix PRs for engineers to review and merge.
community_quotes: The AI that fixes prod autonomously - your AI engineer for production
Connects to Sentry, Datadog - investigates root causes and proposes fixes
Engineers simply review and merge the proposed fixes

name: Spine Swarm
description: A visual workspace for managing and deploying swarms of AI agents that can complete complex tasks from start to finish. Designed as an alternative to chat interfaces with YC backing and claims of SOTA performance on GAIA and DeepSearchQA benchmarks.
community_quotes: Manage a team of AI agents that do real work
Visual workspace instead of chat interfaces for AI agent orchestration
YC-backed, claims to beat OpenAI and Anthropic on research benchmarks

name: Needle 2.0
